name: Kino - Cute
description: This is the voice of a Japanese woman. It is well-suited for a variety of uses, including narration, casual conversation, and anime-style dialogue. Please feel free to use it.

name: Honoka - Clear & Composed
description: A clear and composed Japanese female voice with a cool, confident tone. Calm and steady, suited for narration, explainer videos, audiobooks, and mature, strong-willed characters.

name: Kiyomi - Calm, Warm & Natural
description:
A calm and warm Japanese female voice in her thirties, with a natural, conversational delivery and gentle pacing. Soft yet clear, with a relaxed and reassuring tone that feels like a real person talking.
Best use cases: narration, explainer videos, educational content, conversational content, and audiobooks.
Key qualities: calm, warm, gentle, natural, clear, trustworthy.

name: Tomo - Natural, Clear
description: A Japanese female voice with a natural, clear, and gentle tone. Medium to medium-high pitch, with a conversational speaking style and a calm, expressive delivery. Suitable for storytelling, emotional narration, letters, audiobooks, and heartfelt messages. The voice should sound natural, sincere, and easy to listen to, with clear Japanese pronunciation and subtle emotional nuance.

name: Konomi - Soft & Friendly
description: A soft and friendly female voice in her twenties. Warm, clear, and natural, well suited for game characters, narration, customer guidance, and conversational content. Speaks natural Japanese and clear English.

name: Ruru - Natural, Warm
description: Calm, warm, and natural voice that’s perfect for audiobooks, storytelling, narration, podcasts, voiceovers, meditation, educational content, and more. Whether you’re creating videos, sharing stories, or bringing your ideas to life, this versatile voice adds a smooth, relaxing, and professional touch to any project.

name: Momoka - Bright, Clear & Soothing
description: Warm, sweet female voice, naturally cute and friendly. Never exaggerated, she sounds like a kind friend smiling as she talks to you. Great for conversational AI, app guidance, learning content, and everyday stories.

name: Chihiro - Elegant Japanese Narrator
description:
Chihiro is a native Japanese female voice with a calm, elegant, warm, and sophisticated tone. Her mature, gentle, and natural speaking style is perfect for Japanese narration, audiobooks, videos, podcasts, e-learning, documentaries, corporate presentations, and storytelling.

With clear, natural Japanese pronunciation and a professional yet friendly delivery, Chihiro brings warmth, trust, and authenticity to any project.

name: Akane - Tokyo Standard Japanese
description: Native Japanese female speaker from Tokyo, Japan, with a natural Standard Japanese accent.

name: Mio - Calm Elegant Japanese
description: A calm, elegant Japanese female voice with a soft, warm tone and clear pronunciation. Ideal for narration, audiobooks, documentaries, corporate videos, education, wellness, and storytelling. Natural, soothing, professional, and trustworthy.

name: Jun - Videos
description: This is a voice for use in educational videos—for instance, when teaching English, sharing IT knowledge, or explaining IT technologies.

name: Hanano - Soft
description: Gentle soft feminine voice.

name: Chidori - Calm
description: A calm female voice.

name: Chiemi - Calm & Clear Japanese
description: Calm, clear and articulate Japanese female voice with crisp pronunciation and a gentle, reassuring tone. Ideal for narration, explainers, e-learning, audiobooks, videos and guided meditation.

name: Shino - Natural & Mature
description: A natural, mature Japanese female voice with a calm, clear, and friendly tone. Warm, authentic, and easy to listen to, with natural pacing and clear pronunciation. Ideal for narration, audiobooks, storytelling, educational content, podcasts, and documentaries.

name: Koharu - Calm
description: The calm voice instills a sense of reassurance in the listener.

name: Shijima - Gentle & Soft
description: A gentle, soft middle-aged Japanese male voice for narration and storytelling.

name: Miracle - Engaging Japanese Narrator
description: An engaging Japanese male voice with an energetic, approachable delivery. Well suited to horse racing analysis, sports commentary, educational videos, and training content. A natural, conversational style brings clarity and enthusiasm to detailed explanations.

name: MacLight - Versatile, Deep
description: A deep, clear, and versatile Japanese male voice. Ranging from trustworthy corporate narration to warm conversational delivery and dynamic acting. Ideal for commercials, documentaries, audiobooks, podcasts, and games.

name: Joh - Calm Japanese Male Narration
description: Calm and natural Japanese male narration voice in his 50s, cloned from real online course lectures. Clear, steady delivery that stays easy on the ears over long listening — well suited to e-learning, tutorials, audiobooks, explainer videos and training materials in Japanese.

name: Kohei - Documentary Narrator
description: A composed narration that blends depth with clarity.For documentaries and dramas.

name: Jiro - Polite, Clear Business Presenter
description:
Polite, clear Japanese male voice for business. Standard Japanese with natural keigo, a steady pace, and distinct numbers, dates and loanwords.

Best for: corporate presentations, e-learning, training, explainer videos, product introductions, announcements, data reports, IVR and customer service. Male, 40s.

ビジネス向けの、丁寧で聞き取りやすい標準語の男性の声です。自然な敬語で、数字やカタカナ語もはっきり読みます。プレゼン、eラーニング・研修、解説動画、製品紹介、社内のお知らせ、業績の報告、電話の自動音声に。

name: Taniguchi – A calm, husky, low-pitched
description: A calm, husky, low-pitched voice that delivers clear, easy-to-understand Japanese. It is well-suited for content requiring a composed, steady tone—such as explanatory videos, narration, or dramatic readings.

name: Haruki - Calm & Trustworthy Narrator
description: A calm, gentle male voice with a soft low tone and steady pacing. Ideal for narration, audiobooks, bedtime stories, documentaries and meditation.

name: Rob - Tough & Calloused
description: A tough British man. Gritty, Experienced, Strong.

name: W. Clint Oxley
description: A baritone voice with an intimate and serious demeanor. He has a raspy voice born from his rigorous and tough life. Also great for these categories: narration, educational, advertisement, social media, conversational, and entertainment.

name: Makoto - Calm 60s Japanese
description: Makoto is a deep, composed, and reassuring Japanese male voice in his 60s. Unshakable and calm under any context, this voice brings exceptional maturity, trust, and clarity to every text. Perfect for audiobooks, documentary narrations, business explanations, educational content, and reflective stories.

name: Akio - 47-Year Japanese Authority
description: Enhanced with 3 hours of training data. Upgraded from the original version (260+ users). Drawing from a 47-year career in ICT at a university, including 6 years of admissions PR (20+ presentations/yr), this voice offers unmatched authority and clarity. Ideal for corporate, academic, and professional narration.

name: Jun - Calm, Clear and Husky
description: This is the voice of a middle-aged to elderly Japanese speaker. It is intended for use in calm narration and similar applications.

name: Potato - Earthy & Rooted
description: A deep wooden throat heavy character voice with a distinct German accent. Potato brings a dry, stoic, and earthy momentum, perfect for wise root dwellers, wrinkled wizards, cozy fantasy creatures, and ancient tree-folk. Fully API-ready for indie games, animated cartoons, NPC dialogue, and whimsical storytelling. Earthy, warm, and vibrantly alive, this voice captures immediate attention with an authentic starchy charm. Love this voice? Check other character voices by Alex Vox.

name: David - Professional Narrator
description: French male voice, in his fifties, with a deep, steady tone and a neutral Parisian accent. Refined and warm delivery, ideal for documentary narration, corporate projects, and high-end advertising.

name: Roger One - Rich, Mature & British
description: A rich, mature British voice with natural gravitas and warmth. Clear, articulate, and engaging, this voice is perfect for memoirs, autobiographies, documentaries, and projects requiring authenticity, wisdom, and trust.

name: Noel Natal - Animated Santa Claus
description: A warm and cheerful male voice. Ideal for holiday narration and festive messages, conveying the wisdom and festive spirit that delights all ages.

name: Georg - Funny and Emotional
description: Old German male voice, spoken by a grandfather over 90 years of age, quavering, crackly, and raspy. His voice can shift unexpectedly from fragile and strained to surprisingly dynamic, giving him a comical and humorous charm. In his constant, rambling self-talk, he remains gentle, full of character, and endearing. While he might occasionally snap in a gruff and frustrated tone, he quickly softens, returning to the role of the wise and kind elder despite his schoolmasterly presence of a teacher.

name: Henry - Neutral, Clear and Smoky
description: Deep, intelligent Japanese male villain voice (mid-40s). Authoritative yet comedic - perfect for anime antagonists, game bosses, and storytelling. Strong emotional range from calm menace to dramatic outbursts. Ideal for character dubbing, narrative content, and educational materials. Tokyo standard accent.

name: Anton - Formal and Strong
description: A voice with a deep, resonant baritone that carries a sense of gravity and intensity. The tone is rich and full-bodied. It possesses an underlying tension that is perfect for thriller and true crime recordings. Standard German, no accent.

name: WF Strong
description: Texas NPR Storyteller - Southern Deep Bass Manly comforting tones.

name: P K Anil - Social media Storyteller
description: Natural, grounded, and confident, this Hindi voice tells a real story the way it actually happened, no exaggeration needed. Ideal for storytime videos, personal vlogs, day-in-my-life narration, relatable anecdotes, travel mishaps, and family stories. A strong fit for social media, podcasts, and content creators, podcasters, and storytelling channels building a loyal, engaged audience.

name: Cambero
description: A Brazilian male voice, 44 years old, with a mid-range, commanding timbre. He speaks with the weight of life experience, a slight natural rasp, and a very human, organic rhythm. He has a strong personality and speaks with emotion and dynamic range—shifting between calm, reflective moments and others filled with energy and gravitas. He has a natural Brazilian accent and clear diction, yet sounds like someone who has truly lived the experiences he is describing. This isn't a flawless, robotic narration; it is a sincere conversation from someone with a story to tell.

name: Jerry B. - Announcer & Broadcast Voice
description: This voice delivers a bold, authoritative American male voice ideal for announcer, broadcast, and promotional content. His tone is commanding, polished, and confident, making it perfect for live announce, show opens, event presentation, and branded media. Ideal for promos, network imaging, award shows, live events, and professional announcements that require a strong, attention-grabbing presence.
